independent_solve.reasoning: The formula for bulk modulus is B = -ΔP / (ΔV/V), which implies ΔV = -(ΔP * V) / B. The question asks for the volume contraction (ΔV) but does not provide the initial volume (V) of the copper cube. Without the initial volume, the numerical value of the contraction cannot be calculated. Assuming the question intended to ask for the fractional volume change (ΔV/V) or was missing the volume parameter, it is mathematically unsolvable as stated.
